profiles.method: async-profiler 4.0, cpu-clock 2ms, DWARF native stacks, sampled Java allocations 1m; CPU and allocation profiles from the same process
profiles.limitations: Profile timings excluded. Inclusive counts are not speedups. Sampled Java allocation bytes are estimates, not peak memory, copied bytes or Rust heap totals. Baseline hot profile records 3.28 external CPU seconds; candidate hot profile has no observed external activity. The native-stdout Surefire diagnostic in the hot profile is the profiler startup message; both profiling jobs finish BUILD SUCCESS.

correctness.execution_note: 31-case suites pass on both released Flink lines at both capacities. The nonleading-key case permits a recorded bypass when its working set exceeds the small capacity; normal-capacity coverage retains key reuse. Typed STRING/BIGINT benchmark fixtures also execute with positive native consumption and stock-control exclusion; their 2,000-row smoke timings are not performance claims.
